nom: Drunk Elephant A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum

avis.texte: I use this in the evening before bed. In my first purchase I noticed my eye area was softer with less fine lines-so I kept with it. It exfoliates the eye area without irritating in any way. The area looks fresher and primed for eye cream to plump.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Product does not irritate my skin.Products of similar nature to cause a negative reaction.
I love Drunk Elephant Products. For some reason however, this eye serum is a bit drying for my area.
I have sensitive eyes and this works fine. Soothing and de-puffs.
I've tried about every high-end eye cream on the market this one has given me the best results for fine lines ,wrinkles ,smooth skin under the eye. definite game changer.
I use the product around my eyes on the orbital bone moving up to the brow bone. Just a little bit on my ring finger. I also use it above my upper lip for the vertical lines.

I prefer eye creams that aren't heavy nor greasy. I find this one to be light and moisturizing. Personally, I find that using this one at night and the C-Tango Multivitamin Eye Cream for day work best for me. I use a little concealer and very little cosmetics and get several compliments on my skin overall. Unless they're really bad, this generally helps remove/control any dark circles and/or baggy eyes. I like how these two work for me and will continue using them.

avis.titre: It's a winner WITH the balm
avis.texte: For me and my quite dry skin, this product alone is a bit drying. As other comments indicate, mixed with the ceramide balm, this is terrific, Mostly, I have noticed general tightening of the skin around my eyes, and less dullness

avis.titre: Definitely going to keep getting this
avis.texte: I really love DE in general - I have always had amazing results. I always use the Byoma moisture rich face cream with drunk elephant because their moisturizer in high dry climate is not sufficient with their retinols which are very powerful.

I've been using the serum for a couple years and I've seen a lot of improvement under my eye area, it's a lot smoother. To everyone saying that it's drying, it is very drying if you use it by itself, pair it with your favorite eye cream and the results are amazing! Love love. I don't recommend using it as an eye cream and expect it to have moisture, it helps your eye cream absorb better than it would by itself. Let it dry for a minute or two before layering cream over it.

I have enjoyed the peptide cream for D.E. I have been in search for a good under eye cream. It seems to me this cream has broke me out under my eyes to red patches and a dry sensitive burnimg sensation. Young ladys looking fo a fresh simple "clean" product this is not it
I actually mix this into my face creams and find it an excellent addition!
I love this product, I use it every night as a full face serum amdy skin looks better than ever. It's vibrant and I have less lines. I just wish it came in a 30ml size.

I just started using this product a month ago and it has completely dried out my under eyes. I do not recommend this product especially for young girls. I know this product is the new "in thing" but it's not worth the money or worth drying your face out.

I may have just discovered the holy grail in eye treatments. I have tried so many to no avail. I noticed an immediate difference in the puffiness and softening of fine lines and cannot wait to see the results with long term use. I get regular facials so my skin is used to retinol, but for most people, they should apply sparingly and just a few days a week - working up to daily use. It's always best to let your skin acclimate to retinol, even at a small percentage, especially for the delicate skin around the eye area.

I received the A-Shaba sample with my order. I love all the DE products I have received and have seen overnight results and was disappointed when I did not see overnight results or really any difference using this eye cream. It may work for others and I hope so, but it does not for me.

avis.titre: Love this eye cream… the 1st one not to irritate my eyes
avis.texte: Absolutely thrilled with this product by Drunken Elephant! I'm 62 years old and know I should have been using an eye cream for years… this is the very first I've found that did not make my eyes burn. Thank you, Drunken Elephant.

avis.titre: The best Retinols for AM routine
avis.texte: The Drunk Elephant retinols make my skin so happy! I use A-Passioni cream and the A-Gloel every day with a dollop of the A-Shaba on the eyes and I am good to go with a little spf. Keeps my skin feeling moist and smooth all day with no burn (I am not a retinol beginner). Love these produxts, and yeah the funky smell and texture is because these are clean products instead of chemicals! ❤️❤️❤️

avis.auteur: Will age your under eye area
avis.titre: Made under eyes look more aged
avis.texte: Been using this for less than a week and my under eyes look more crepey and aged. This product produces a slightly burning sensation and overall I've experienced a loss of firmess ans drying as a result. Will be returning. Should have heeded the bad reviews.
Purchased this product for fine lines and puffiness under eyes. After using for over a week I see no difference. Absorbs well feels light but I see no difference for the price

I used the original formula and it did nothing for me so I switched brands. The other brand redid their formula and added propylene glycol, which I'm allergic to. I went back to DE's updated eye cream and found it actually worked better than the previous version! I use it in the mornings and a different brand at night.
I don't like to spend this much on skin care but I've been using the other products so I decided to try it. It didn't do anything the first few weeks of using it then made my eyes itchy and swollen.

Used it for about 2 weeks, noticed extremely dried out skin under eyes. I stopped using it and my under eye area was back to what it was. It's the retinol, not everyone can use retinol in the under eye area. The other Shaba eye product was a much better product.
After only two applications, my eyelids and under eyes were swollen and burnt to a crisp. It took about a week to heal. Customer service did nothing but send me a very small lotion sample

I live for this product. I have tired eyes and this makes them look alive. They feel so smooth and it works so nice under my concealer. I'm a freak with concealer constantly going thru them. I love a good eye product and this is one of them.

avis.titre: I do not care for this product.
avis.texte: It is not what I would like it to do. It is not the product I came into the store to purchase, but the sales person convinced me it was far better. I am not happy with this product at all.

avis.titre: Burns! I miss the original Shaba.
avis.texte: I used the original Shaba twice a day. Tried the same with this one and it feels tight and burns. It actually makes my under eye bags bigger! Please bring back the old gentle formula!
I returned this. I used it for a few days in a row, and it made the skin around my eyes irritated and itchy. I'm not sure whether it was was retinol or caffeine that irritated my skin.

Got this after reading all thr positive reviewe and some other drhnk elephant products. Unfortunaly this one made me wake up completly red under the eyes, with burning sensation! Stopped usuing immediatly and was left with peely undereyes! Be careful with this product !!

avis.titre: Improvement in eye puffiness and fine lines
avis.texte: I have been using the A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum for the last 5 months and am really happy with the results. My eyes look less puffy and tired. I've been combining it with the C-Tango Multivitamin Eye Cream, which was a suggested smoothie and have noticed a reduction in the dark colors under my eyes and a reduction in a few of the finer lines around my eyes.

I have to say, I'm honestly surprised at some of these reviews. Unlike others, I'm happy that DE decided to add retinol to this eye serum. The research regarding retinol and its benefit in an eye serum are undisputed. While the original formula was good, this formula is better. I'm not wondering if perhaps those who are having issues with the retinol is simply because they are either using too much product at one time, or using it too often to begin with. Retinol is a product which one must allow their skin to be accustomed to gradually as to not cause some of the reported issues. Additionally, as with all DE products, less is more. I find that less than one pump for both eyes is more than enough. As far as results, at 59 years old, I have no crows feet, no under eye creping, and no dark circles. I believe the reason for this is not only the use of the original formula, but also the continued use of the new formula. The addition of the retinol is a plus, not a reason to prohibit or discontinue use.

Ive been using this product for a week now which i figured is a good timeframe for a review. Usually before using this, i clean my face with a make up remover towel and ever since using this, it feels so irritated and painful under the eyes that i can't wipe my face without feeling like glass is shredding my under eyes.

I bought this product due to the writeups and the hype, I used it for 2 days and have a burn on my eyelid and swelling, it's been a week and still not healed. Won't be buying any of their products again. Think twice before buying

avis.titre: Worst eye cream; burned my skin
avis.texte: I do not have sensitive skin and can tolerate a lot of products without reactions. This is the absolute worst, and it has damaged my undereyes! It burned my under eyes, and made my under eyes rough and bumpy. I will be returning this ASAP!!!
I don't have sensitive skin but after a few days my eye area became irritated, dry & very sensitive. Worse was that lines & wrinkles became more pronounced. PLEASE BEING BACK OG that was spectacular.

avis.titre: Bring back original Shaba eye cream!
avis.texte: I have been a loyal DE customer since the beginning(I even used Wonderbar for years prior to DE!). I have used the Shaba eye cream since the beginning and recommended to others. I used it daily and religiously. I HATE the new formula. I am using it at night so I don't waste the money, but I will not repurchase. I am using a competitor for daytime which I don't like nearly as well. Please, please bring back the original Shaba eye formula!!!!

So far I haven't noticed and changes, good or bad. I'm only 23 so I started using this to hopefully combat the wrinkles that will inevitably form around my eyes. I constantly have dark circles that are more pronounced with how pale my skin is. The product itself does not cause any irritation for me and a little goes a long way. I use it nightly along with other DE products.
I'm not seeing any improvement. Very lightweight cream and is not as nourishing as other products on the market
I rarely write reviews, but I've had the same experience as others. The retinol is very drying - would love to have the old formula back.

avis.titre: burned the skin around my eyes
avis.texte: I wanted to love this, but after 2 weeks of using it I just kept getting more irritated. I felt like I had a chemcial burn. it was awful.
Why change a good thing? You took a great formula and made it worse. Now it's an overpriced vial of garbage. You ruined my eye cream! I'll never forgive you.

Maybe it's because I have somewhat sensitive skin, but this dried out the skin around my eyes. My skin burned and even peeled after using consistently for a week or two. Pretty disappointed since it's so expensive, and I'm unable to use it.

I was about to re-order Shaba in the aqua bottle when I discovered my "old fave" is gone -- replaced by this new "upgraded" formula in a pink bottle that contains retinol. WHAT?!!! It took me years and years to find an eye cream I could use on my eyelids without irritation and now it's gone. I wouldn't dare use this new formula anywhere near my lids so back to searching for eye creams.......

I wanted to love this but it's just eh. It's nice and lightweight. It doesn't have a fragrance which is nice. If you don't really pat it into skin it's dries kind of crusty and flakes off skin. It also hasn't done anything for fine lines or dark discoloration at all and I've been using it for months.
It does what it says it does and it makes my eyes like nice I love
Don't like the change in formula. bring back the old Shaba eye serum in the blue bottle!

I don't know why they added retinol to this otherwise perfect serum. The previous version was so lightweight, hydrating, and had such unique ingredients you couldn't easily find in other serums. Retinol eye serums are a dime a dozen out there and this just joined the fray at 3x the price of others.

avis.titre: Not worth the money- 0 results after 4 months
avis.texte: I've been using this product for 4 months and I don't see any difference. For this price, you can get way better options. Drunk Elephant has been disappointing me time and time again. You are just paying for cute packaging. The pump also leaves product with each use that dries out at the tip, which consistently wastes cream.

i have the drunk elephant protini moisturizer, and it worked great for me, and because i didn't have any eye cream i bought this product. it worked like your average eye cream for about 3 days, but then the problem started. my under eyes started being really dry and peeling. i thought it was some other product i was using, but as i kept using the a shaba it just got worse. sadly didn't work for me but everyone is different.

Gifted by drunk elephant. First of all, I LOVE the packaging. I also like how this eye cream is thin but still feels very hydrating. I have sensitive eyes but this eye cream doesn't make my eyes water or sting.

avis.titre: ACTUALLY reduces fine lines and crows feet!
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a little over a month and I have been super impressed with the results. I have tried loads of high and anti-aging eye creams, and I finally found the one for me! I enjoy the non-sticky formula and the results I am getting. You twist the top of the bottle to expose the pump, which I love! The bottle seems to be lasting a long time, making it even more cost effective. Finally found my holy grail eye cream! Seriously, just add it to the cart already😍😂

I've been using this eye serum for quite a while now. This is definitely in my top three. I used to use an eye serum worth $250. It worked wonders but it's sooo pricey. I found this alternative from Drunk Elephant and I couldn't be more pleased! I wasn't expecting for it to be so similar to a luxury product. This is worth the money and I will be buying again in the near future!
I'm a big fan of Drunk Elephant products and this is no exception to that. I've noticed an improvement after just a couple of uses. My under eyes don't look as tired and I'm loving it!

avis.titre: I used to have really bad eyebags. In ever since I used this
avis.texte: I definitely recommend getting this year on it works really well. It worked really well under my eyes and I see an improvement. This is the best skin care ever definitely get drunk elephant. I know the price is high, but it's worth it.

I am 31 and have tired looking eyes—fine lines, dark circles, puffiness, etc. I put it on at night before bed and I think it makes a big difference! Makes me not look like a zombie lol. Don't use every day since it has retinol, 2-3 times per week and have not had a bad skin reaction.

avis.titre: Amazing under eye cream- helps with fine lines.
avis.texte: Leaves under eye feeling smooth, firm, and helps with dark circles
This product and other drink elephant products have been a game changer for my skin! I recommend these products to everyone who asks. My skin has never been better
sadly de ruined a good thing by adding caffine and retinol to an already fine eye serum. causes chemical burns and irritation

I've been using DE Shaba for a couple months f years and loved it. I didn't realize they changed the formula with my most recent purchase until my eyes would not stop burning. I don't really have sensitive skin so not sure what is in it that is irritating my skin. It's really unfortunate because I love their products and the old eye cream really worked!

avis.titre: I liked! Good texture and hydration
avis.texte: I bought this product in order to help pufiness and hydration

avis.titre: The only DE product I still use
avis.texte: I honestly can't believe this only has 3 stars. It's the only thing I can still use from DE, which is a bummer cuz I loved everything I wss using. Switched ALL my skincare to DE , only to find it was making me break out..... because EVERYTHING is LOADED with pore clogging ingredients! I had to switch it all out for pore friendly products ( farmacy has been a godsend) BUT my acne was only on my chin and jawline , so the eye cream can stay, and thank GOD for that because this is BY FAR the best eye serum I've ever used. Crows feet gone, dark circles gone and the skin under my eyes looks AMAZING. The other 2 eye creams from DE are alright I guess, but you can get the same thing elsewhere for much cheaper. But THIS is the only eye serum I'll ever use again for night time.

i don't understand why they would discontinue the original a-shaba eye serum. i already use a retinoid at night so don't want to use duplicate retinols. I want a daytime eye serum (not going to do retinol during the day). will have to look for another eye serum now that is more similar to the original formulation :/

avis.titre: Do not buy unless you want dry, red under-eyes!
avis.texte: My daughter used this product for 3-4 days and woke up with puffy, red eyes where she had been applying it. The skin started to peel and her under eye area was very dry and irritated. After 2 days of not using, the skin started to clear up. Buyer beware!
I love the brand but this eye cream is too harsh for my eyes area. It gave me red rash and burn for a week.

avis.titre: Not a fan of DE products
avis.texte: Drunk Elephant has soooo many high star reviews and YouTube influencers are always promoting their products. I just don't see it. This eye cream does absolutely nothing for my under eyes. Cant wait to use it up so I can move on to something else. Will not repurchase.
I bought this at Ulta and it is soooooooooo good 😌 I absolutely love it 😍 it makes my skin so soft and smooth 💅

I have been using this retinol eye cream every day for 5 weeks now and it's absolutely amazing! My fine lines have diminished and some have completely disappeared after just 3 weeks! People leave bad reviews on this must have absolutely no clue how retinol works. Yes, it's pretty strong so you have to start very small and work your way up there. Your skin will peel under the eyes, use a moisturizer. But this product is incredible, definitely my new holy grail staple product!

I have had stubborn milia my entire adult life. I am a chronic eye cream tester, I have yet to find "the one." This eye cream will definitely be my new night eye treatment, forever! Those milia are one by one going away after regular use. The texture is definitely weird, but with some gentle manipulation it will work into your eye area. I had low expectations when I started trying this cream, I have used more expensive products with disappointing results, this exceeded all my preconceived notions about eye creams. I just love it!

avis.titre: Burns and stings! Original was far superior!
avis.texte: Why change the perfect old Shaba complex? This is not good, it burns and fair enough the retinol works but I hate when companies do this! Make a new product if you must but keep the original for the people that loved it

I used the original Shaba eye serum for years and loved it. The retinol is too harsh for my eyes and after repeated use irritates my skin to the point of hurting. I'm going to have to alternate it with a much more moisturizing eye cream to use it up. I hope they bring back the old formula, as the other drunk elephant eye creams are too thick for me.

avis.titre: Big expectations I'm sure will be met
avis.texte: I believe in this product, and will give a full review when I've used it for a little longer. I'm sure it is a valuable addition to my anti[aging routine. Love the texture so far, and it does not make any eye makeup run.

avis.titre: Alernate use if it irritates or does not work for
avis.texte: I bought this several months ago and was not impressed but it was too late to return it. I found an alternate use based on ingredients. I started using on my lip lines and it works pretty good. If you are in the same situation you may want to give it a try.
I just purchased this eye cream and it doesn't absorb well. It just feels like mineral sunscreen and just sits on the skin

avis.titre: Need the orginal Shaba Eye Serum Back!!!!
avis.texte: please bring back he orginal Shaba Eye Serum!! Suggest use to is to apply sunscreen.... I don't know of any sunscreen to apply on my eye lids that won't irriate or burn my eyes!!!!!!

I haven't had this bad a reaction to an eye product in a long time. Having just purchased the ice box set and hdbing zerp issue woth thise products I purchased this serum. Horrible mistake. Looks like i have a fever around my eyes. So dry. Super itchy. Puffy beyond recognition. Bright red circles around my whole eye. Skip it. on to the next.

I have very sensitive skin and eyes and have no issues with any other DE product. I wish this product wouldn't be so horrible because I wanted to love it. Please change this formula!

This is a good eye cream, it's very moisturizing and around my eyes look 10x better since I started using it. I had some puffiness and the skin around my eyes felt so dry before but this product has helped so much with that. Gifted by Drunk Elephant
This ice cream is amazing. It even came with a little travel size and the packaging was absolutely gorgeous.

I received this product as a free sample and it has been the worst product I have ever used! i used it for two weeks and this product literally burned my eye area. I had an unbearable burning sensation. I really do not recommend it.

I received this eye serum complimentary from Drunk Elephant! I've actually never tried their products but this stuff is amazing! My undereyes looked so hydrated and a lot of my darkness went away! Definitely recommend!

I was very excited to try this deluxe sample, but it's definitely not for me. After a few days I've noticed my undereye area feels thinner and even more dry than before I started using it. Lately I've noticed the skin actually burns when I apply it, so in the garbage it goes. I don't have sensitive skin and use other retinol products with no problems.

It just work for me. My skin is sensitive and this product was very harsh.
I have sensitive skin and have used it for two weeks and it dried my skin under my eyes. I love drunk elephant products but I would not buy this product again.

So basically the product did not help me, my face broke out. My face was red and i wouldn't recommend for other people. This product is also way to overpriced for it not to even help my skin but damage it.

My skin is very sensitive. I splurged on this eye serum, thinking the high price would translate into a product that didn't irritate my skin. I was wrong - it's worse than the eye cream I used before. The skin around my eyes is red and peeling since I started using this. It hurts. I'm scaling back my use from every day to every other day to see if it helps, but I don't feel hopeful. I don't doubt that this is a great product for some (perhaps even most), but for me the price was not justified.
Love the feel of it on my skin! Will definitely purchase again.
Drunk elephant stuff is really good but you can get much better for much much much cheaper.

This product was sent complimentary from Drunk Elephant. All opinions are my own. The Drunk Elephant A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum is lightweight, moisturizing, and plumping. It gives my under eye the boost it desperately needs daily. It is formulated with 0.1% vegan retinol, 3% caffeine, and copper peptides that targets fine lines and wrinkles and reduces puffiness. it is definitely my new go to eye serum! LOVE IT!

This eye cream is another hit by Drink Elephant! It is a nice lightweight texture but gives so much hydration to my under eye. Most retinol products are too strong and cause my skin to be irritated but not this one. It has helped to calm down my puffiness and reduce the appearance of my fine lines arriving my eyes. My eyes have not looked/felt better as they do now with this serum. I like to apply it at night after washing my face and before my night cream. My sensitive eyes didn't have any reactions to this at all. Gifted by Drunk Elephant

I received this complimentary from Drunk Elephant for review. Firming, fine lines and overall anti aging are my main skincare goals in my mid 30s, and I love how my skin looks after applying this eye cream. The fine lines are less noticeable and my skin texture looks smoother. I also like the mess free applicator.

This eye cream has replaced all of my eye creams! I am absolutely obsessed, and it is the only eye cream that has shown fast, visible results. It is now a staple in my morning routine and I use it everyday. I will continue to repurchase over and over! - gifted by Drunk Elephant

I received the A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum complimentary from Drunk Elephant. I've been using it for about a week and a half. I've noticed my under eyes look more hydrated, smoother and less puffy. A very small amount will get the job done for my eyes so this is a product that will last me a a good amount of time. So far, it's a 10/10.

I LOVE this serum. I am a big skeptic of products that offer quick results but this does the trick for me. I notice an immediate difference in the size and color of my under eye bags that last for about three hours. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and am starting to notice an overall change as well. Product was gifted by Drunk Elephant.

*gifted by Drunk elephant* A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum by @drunkelephant Made with 0.1% vegan retinol, 3% antioxidant-rich caffeine and copper peptides to help reduce puffiness, fine lines, & wrinkles. The texture is a thick serum that feels very lightweight once applied on your eye area. Love that it keeps my eye area hydrated and helps prevent wrinkles. I have been loving this serum so far

I really like this serum. I feel like it is intensely hydrating and adds a plumpness to my skin in that sensitive area. I also adore the packaging on this- properly cute. I would highly recommend this. Gifted by drunk elephant

avis.titre: Helps to improve under eye skin
avis.texte: I have some light dark circles and loose skin under eyes. Previously I was just ignoring these flaws but after giving this cream a try for more than a week in my i can say this helped to improve my dark circles for some extent. I like how it key under eye skin hydrated . Even it helped to depuff my eyes. Its gentle on my skin as my under eyes shin is little sensitive than face. It literally doesn't not irritate my eye skin.

I was gifted by Drunk Elephant and have been using this eye cream for the past couple weeks and have seen a decrease in puffy ness and tiredness. I love all drunk elephant products but this eye cream will stay in my beauty shelf for thé future.

I am already such a huge fan of Drunk Elephant and their amazing clean formulas, and I am in love with this new eye serum! It is so lightweight and I have seen such an improvement in the areas under my eyes. Gifted by drunk elephant.

I received this product complimentary from Drunk Elephant, and let me tell you, it's a game changer! This is the first drunk elephant product I've tried and I do not regret it! My under eyes have never looked so good 😮‍💨 it's helped with my dark circles and keeps my under eyes moisturized as well. It sits very well under my makeup as well. I keep my Eye serum in the fridge, I believe this helps the product do it's job 10x better! Definitely recommend 🫶🏽

I'm so happy drunk elephant gifted me this new eye serum that comes in the cutest bottle and really hydrates the eye area so nicely and feels like such great quality. Excited to have this added on to my routine

This product was gifted by drunk elephant. I have never tried their products before and I really enjoyed this eye serum. I have really dark and puffy eyes. I don't notice a difference yet for darkness but it really helps smooth out the area before applying makeup. I'll have to see how this goes with time!

This serum was gifted by Drunk Elephant and works wonders! It is extremely lightweight & there isn't any pilling. The first time I used it I could instantly feel the skin around my eyes firm up! I've never used a product that gave me results like that! My bags are visibly less puffy and my eyes feel/ look more awake and vibrant! I have used it consistently for two weeks, and there has been an apparent improvement of the texture under my eyes and the fine lines around my eyes. I also love that this product incorporates natural ingredients and is cruelty free!

I'm somewhat of an eye cream junkie at this point - I have tried just about every kind. This one is a mid-weight, serum textured cream that sinks in quickly and leaves no greasy residue. It's yellowish in color, like the best retinol serums, and has no scent. I have been using this morning and night with no irritation (I do wear sunscreen during the day, even on cloudy days, even under makeup). I've noticed pretty quick results with this; I'd say they're more the effect of the caffeine than the retinol after just 2 weeks, but I have faith they'll continue to improve. I normally wake up very puffy (see top photo) but putting this on before bed has reduced that quite a bit (middle photo). It also looks fabulous under makeup (bottom photo) & does not cause pilling or patchiness. Overall I'd say this is a win! The one thing I don't like is the dispenser - I like the airless pump, but whenever I twist it closed, it gets a small bead of product stuck in the top & it gets cruddy quick. It's a novel design but maybe not the best for this particular product. Gifted by drunkelephant for my review.

I absolutely love this product! It for sure helps me with puffiness in the morning and that has to be one of my favorite things!! I also love putting this in my skincare fridge because it's so cooling in my under eyes when I apply it! Also, a little bit goes a long way!! Trust me when I say that! This product will last me a while! This was gifted by Drunk Elephant!

This eye serum works great for my tired mom eyes. It's very hydrating and really improves the texture and firmness around my eyes and my makeup applies very smoothly whenever I use this. Complimentary from DrunkElephant

Gifted by drunk elephant. I love trying out new eye creams and im happy that this one works for sensitive skin. This is lightweight and i see a slight difference in puffiness under my eyes. Also love the convenience of the pump packaging
This is a real review and i have to say I absolutely love this eye cream. My eyes look so bright and smooth and concealer goes on really nice to. Im 42 and this eye cream is the real deal .

The best!! I noticed a difference in my eyes right away!! the cream feels and smells good and the packaging is great! could not recommend an eye product more!!! drunk elephant has always made great products but this one is exceptional!! gifted by drunk elephant!

The goat of eye creams. Before I started using this eye serum, my under eyes were deep, pigmented, textured and often dry depending on the season.
